summary: Clackamas County, OR lookout site: 1915 log cabin, L-4 cab from 1932, removed 1964-66; the summit still holds stone steps, metal sheets and window glass.

facts.design: Log cabin with attached roof platform (1915), replaced by a standard L-4 cab in 1932
facts.status_note: Cab removed by 1966; the summit still holds stone steps, rusting sheet metal, window glass and part of a stay cable

staffing.status: Newspaper items name Chas. Frazier (1915), Ralph Reed (1916) and Mrs. W. Wash with her daughter Eva (1918) in charge; later staffing not in the sources read

access.note: On Mt. Hood NF. A July 2025 visitor walked in from forest roads and mentions no gate. Oregon Hikers tags its summit routes 'Closed' without saying why.

visit.trail_note: Park at the NF-220 junction on NF-4670; the summit is 1.42 miles round trip with 339 feet of gain, mostly along the NF-220 road

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Mt. Hood National Forest

events.note: Log cabin with attached roof platform, per FFLOS, firelookout.com and The Roaming Civic; Oregon Hikers says 1916 (see resolved_conflicts)
Estacada Progress, July 1915: Chas. Frazier would be stationed on Mt. Lowe
Ralph Reed in charge of the station, per Eastern Clackamas News (September 1916)
Mrs. W. Wash and daughter Eva in charge, per Eastern Clackamas News (July and September 1918)
Log cabin replaced by a standard L-4 ground cabin
Inspection report dated August 22, 1963: the building is old and should be replaced
Gone by 1966 per FFLOS and firelookout.com; The Roaming Civic says removed between 1964 and 1966
Registered August 26, 2010; nominated by Ray Kresek

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS, firelookout.com and The Roaming Civic give 1915; Oregon Hikers gives 1916; an Estacada Progress item from July 1914 reports a new fire station being built on Mt. Lowe. The story uses 1915 and says the start date is not settled.

A header block on The Roaming Civic page reads 'Currently standing; abandoned' with an elevation of 5,249 ft. The same page gives 5,334 ft for Lowe and says the cabin was removed between 1964 and 1966, so the header probably describes the neighboring Hawk Mountain post and was not used. Status set to gone.

notes_for_editor: FFLOS and firelookout.com agree on 1915, the 1932 L-4 cab and gone by 1966. Oregon Hikers gives 1916 and the 1914 newspaper item points earlier; both flagged. The Oregon Hikers route tags say 'Closed' with no explanation; check Mt. Hood NF notices before publishing the access line. Not verified on the ground. No licensed photo found.
